title: Azadaron ki manzil
body:
hamari shaan karbala hamari jaan karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
azadaron ki manzil karbala hai
lahoo mein inki shaamil karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein itni kashish bhar gaye hussain
jo ek baar jayega har baar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
farishte aasman waalon ki saff se
jabeen malne dar e shaahe najaf se
tajjalli paane noorani sharaf se
chale aate hai zaair har taraf se
har ek kashti ka saahil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha jannat ne jannat karbala ko
na bhaaye kis liye ahle aza ko
amal lagta hai ye acha khuda ko
mussalle par rakho khaake shifa ko
is aaine ke qaabil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein jaa ke ye kehte hai zaireen
jannat se uthke kaun samajhdaar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
hai charcha karbala ka aasman par
qaseeda hai rasoolon ki zaban par
wahan se kam nahi raunaq yahan par
na itrao falak waalon jina par
zameen waalon ko haasil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan is ka sharaf kaabe se kam hai
nigaahe kibriya mein mohtaram hai
isi ki chaaun mein roohe haram hai
hamay jaane se roke kis mein dam hai
ke ham sab ka mustaqbil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
khush hoke dil se us ko laga legi karbala
hurr ban ke jab bhi koi gunahgar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
musalmano khuda ka khauf khao
ziyarat is ki mat biddat batao
wafa kuch to mohamed se nibhao
chalo tum bhi hamare saath aao
nabi ke deen ka dil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
badan se jab nikal jaati hai roohein
kahan ki hai ye batlaati hai roohein
dar e shabbir pe aati hai roohein
ye khush ho ho ke chillati hai roohein
khuda waalon ki mehfil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaata hai kis ke saath bhala kaun qabr mein
khaake shifa ke saath azadaar jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
wafa hum se nibhati hai lehad tak
hamara dil badhati hai lehed tak
sahara deti jaati hai lehed tak
hamare saath aati hai lehed tak
hamara radde mushkil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitaare aamir o akhtar falak par
fida hai iske zarron ki chamak par
bichate hai yahan apne malak par
hai iski roshni kaabe talak par
ab us manzil mein daakhil karbala hai
azadaron ki manzil...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
